script.title: PASSPORT PHOTOS, TAKE TWO
script.story_hook: Two passport photos, three tries, one kind clerk.
script.intro_zh: 兩張護照相片，拍了三次，遇到友善的櫃員。
script.welcome_en: Welcome, welcome! Today we're taking passport photos.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎歡迎！今天我們要拍護照用的相片。
script.outro: Two perfect photos! Keep listening, and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 兩張完美的護照相拍好啦！繼續多聽，我們下次再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat after me, one line at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請跟著我，一句一句地重複。
script.char_a_description: a lanky man in his mid twenties with messy flaxen curls, wearing an oversized gray hoodie, a backpack strap slipping off one shoulder as he fidgets
script.char_b_description: a poised woman in her forties with glossy black hair in a tight low bun, wearing pearl studs and a navy studio smock, measuring backdrops with a tape
script.youtube_title: 【📸護照拍照眉角多】「眼睛盯著那個點」怎麼說？18句沖印英文🎧聽完就會拍💡｜🌱A2初級｜Passport Photo English
script.youtube_title_en: "Second Time's the Charm" — Getting Passport Photos
script.youtube_description:
拍張護照相片，原來規矩這麼多？不能戴眼鏡、不能大笑、頭髮還不能亂！跟著 Ben 在沖印機台前多拍了一輪，學會最真實的英文應答與安撫。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢去拍。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Did you know passport photos come with strict rules? No glasses, no big smiles, no messy hair. Follow Ben at the photo kiosk as a kind clerk fixes each little mistake and talks him through a redo — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section at the end.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📸拍護照相片英文｜摘掉眼鏡・坐正望點・沖洗照片｜聽完就會拍照｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
拍張護照相片，也要你重來一次嗎？
眼鏡、微笑、瀏海，到底哪裡不合格？

這一集帶大家走進沖印店小小的拍照區，跟著 Ben 從摘掉眼鏡、收起大笑、把瀏海往後梳，到閃光燈害他眨眼後再來一次，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧍 拍照要求：例如「Neutral face, lips closed, eyes on the dot.」。
👓 修正小狀況：例如「Sorry, no glasses — take them off, please.」。
😅 重拍與打氣：例如「Second time's the charm, right?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次要拍證件照，你一點也不怕啦！
script.thumbnail_action: sitting up straight before a white backdrop

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need passport photos taken today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid ˈpæspɔrt ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈteɪkən təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我今天需要拍護照用的相片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're in luck — no line at all right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ɪn lʌk noʊ laɪn ət ɔl raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你很幸運——現在完全不用排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! How many pictures do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpɪktʃərz du aɪ ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！你會給我幾張照片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six prints, two sets for the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /siks prɪnts tu sɛts fɔr ðə fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 共六張，分成兩組給申請表用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good. Um, do I pay before or after?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd ʌm du aɪ peɪ bɪˈfɔr ɔr ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 好。呃，我要先付錢還是事後付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After, it's fifteen dollars when you're done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ɪts ˈfɪftin ˈdɑlərz wɛn jʊr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 事後付，拍完一共十五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… can I keep my glasses on, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ kæn aɪ kip maɪ ˈɡlæsəz ɑn ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那……我可以戴著眼鏡拍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, no glasses — take them off, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri noʊ ˈɡlæsəz teɪk ðɛm ɔf pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請把眼鏡摘下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. What about smiling? I look better smiling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈsmaɪlɪŋ aɪ lʊk ˈbɛtər ˈsmaɪlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。那可以微笑嗎？我笑起來比較好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neutral face, lips closed, eyes on the dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʊtrəl feɪs lɪps kloʊzd aɪz ɑn ðə dɑt/
dialogue.zh: 臉要自然，嘴巴闔上，眼睛望著那個點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like… that? Does my hair look messy here?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðæt dʌz maɪ hɛr lʊk ˈmɛsi hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 像……這樣嗎？我這裡的頭髮看起來亂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One strand over your brow — smooth it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn strænd ˈoʊvər jɔr braʊ smuð ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 有一撮瀏海蓋住眉毛——往後梳好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better? I want to get this right, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər aɪ wɑn tə ɡɛt ðɪs raɪt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 好點了？老實說，我想一次就拍好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're nailing it. Sit straight — there we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈneɪlɪŋ ɪt sɪt streɪt ðɛr wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你做得很棒。坐正——對，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that good? The flash made me blink.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ɡʊd ðə flæʃ meɪd mi blɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛那張好嗎？閃光燈害我眨眼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost! Blink ruins one set, let's redo it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst blɪŋk ˈruɪnz wʌn sɛt lɛts ˈridu ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 差一點！眨眼會毀掉一組，我們再來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, sorry! Second time's the charm, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ˈsɑri ˈsɛkənd taɪmz ðə tʃɑrm raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，抱歉！第二次一定會成功，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly! These came out great — here you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðiz keɪm aʊt ɡreɪt hɪr ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣！洗出來非常漂亮——給你。
